answer.book: Sixtini Amama, Anti-barbarus biblicus (Franeker, Elzevir 1656 printing of the 1628 text): one work in four books (Liber I-IV) with prefatory dedications, prefaces and orations up front; Liber I is divided into error-sections and numbered chapters, and Liber II-IV into biblical books and their chapters and observations.
